title: Scroll curl screens: case panels that lean back as they leave, by speed
summary: Full-width case screens (links with headings) inside list items that carry `perspective: 1500px` (900 px on a phone), each turned `rotateX` about its bottom edge by `34° × smoothstep(0, .65, exit progress) × energy`, where exit progress comes from a ScrollTrigger per item (`top top` → `bottom top`) and energy is the scroll speed from Lenis' scroll events over `1,400 px/s`, clamped to 1, damped up at `k 12` and down at `k 3.2`; each angle follows at `k 14` with framerate-independent `damp()` on the shared ticker, adds `scale(1 − .05 × lean)` and a shade to `.45`, is capped at 34° whatever the fling, and returns to flat about a second after the scroll goes quiet; the ticker wakes on scroll and removes itself once every screen is flat, a parked half-gone screen is flat, a focused screen is flat at once; reduced motion and static never tilt
variants: lean from position × speed, flat at rest (this, default)
lean from position alone, damped: a screen keeps its curl while parked half out
the same lean entering from below, about the top edge, for screens arriving as well as leaving
